2608.19971.title: Robust Incomplete Multimodal Sentiment Analysis via Iterative Proxy Correction
2608.19971.paper_summary: Multimodal sentiment analysis aims to infer affective states by integrating language, visual, and acoustic cues. However, real-world multimodal inputs are often incomplete or corrupted, which can weaken cross-modal complementarity and introduce misleading information into downstream fusion. Existing proxy-based methods for incomplete MSA commonly rely on one-shot proxy construction to compensate for degraded language information, but the generated proxy may be coarse or unreliable at initialization. Prematurely injecting such a proxy into multimodal reasoning can propagate initial errors and compromise sentiment prediction. To address this limitation, we propose an iterative proxy correction framework for robust incomplete MSA. Our method constructs a language-oriented proxy from non-language modalities and progressively refines it under multimodal context through gated residual correction. The corrected proxy is then adaptively fused with the observed language representation according to an estimated language reliability score, allowing the model to balance proxy-based compensation and trustworthy linguistic evidence. In addition, we introduce a stage-wise latent correction objective that uses the complete language representation as a training-time semantic anchor to stabilize the proxy refinement trajectory. Extensive experiments on MOSI, MOSEI, and SIMS under diverse missing-modality settings demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently outperforms competitive baselines and achieves robust sentiment prediction under incomplete inputs.
2608.19971.paper_summary_zh: 多模態情感分析旨在通過整合語言、視覺和聲音線索來推斷情感狀態。<lb/>然而，現實世界中的多模態輸入往往是不完整或受損的，這可能削弱跨模態的互補性並引入誤導性信息到下游融合中。<lb/>現有的基於代理的方法通常依賴一次性代理構建來補償退化的語言信息，但生成的代理在初始化時可能粗糙或不可靠。<lb/>過早地將這樣的代理注入多模態推理中可能會傳播初始錯誤並妨礙情感預測。<lb/>為了解決這一限制，我們提出了一個迭代代理修正框架，以實現穩健的不完整多模態情感分析。<lb/>我們的方法從非語言模態構建一個以語言為導向的代理，並通過門控殘差修正在多模態上下文中逐步精煉它。<lb/>然後，根據估計的語言可靠性分數，將修正後的代理自適應地與觀察到的語言表示融合，允許模型在基於代理的補償和可信的語言證據之間取得平衡。<lb/>此外，我們引入了一個階段性潛在修正目標，利用完整的語言表示作為訓練時的語義錨點，以穩定代理修正的軌跡。<lb/>在多種缺失模態設置下，對MOSI、MOSEI和SIMS的廣泛實驗表明，所提出的框架始終超越競爭基線，並在不完整輸入下實現穩健的情感預測。
